description: Wallets that sent the most USDC to indexed payTo addresses in the last N days, ranked by TOTAL USDC volume — NOT by x402 settlements. Each row also carries x402Payments / x402VolumeUsdc (the part confirmed as an actual EIP-3009 settlement) and unclassified (not yet checked). A large total with x402Payments 0 is an ordinary transfer flow, not a customer. Useful for prospecting once you read the x402 columns.
name: mainstreet_top_buyers
